name: io.github.BetaNYC/nys-openlegislation-mcp
title: NYS Open Legislation
description: NY State bills, laws, members, committees, calendars and transcripts from NYS Open Legislation

environmentVariables.name: NYS_LEGISLATION_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free NYS Open Legislation API key, needed for live data. Optional only if a local corpus exists

environmentVariables.name: NYS_CORPUS_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the optional local corpus database. Defaults to data/corpus.db in the package
